name: Empty States
description: Three empty states in one component: inbox zero, no search results and first project, each with a hand-drawn SVG scene, real copy and clear next steps.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which empty state, illustration and default copy to show.

props.name: meta
props.description: Small mono line above the title, e.g. "Inbox · 0 unread".

props.name: title
props.description: Headline. For search it defaults to “Nothing matches” followed by the query in italic serif.

props.name: body
props.description: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: query
props.description: Search variant: the query that found nothing.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Search variant: alternative queries shown as chips.

props.name: onSuggestion
props.description: Called when a suggestion chip is pressed.

props.name: templates
props.description: Project variant: templates shown as chips under a dashed rule.

props.name: onTemplate
props.description: Called when a template chip is pressed.

props.name: illustration
props.description: Hide the drawing in tight spaces.
